subject: Cold start
content: Cloud Run cold starts take about three seconds with the current image, mostly spent importing the Python dependencies and connecting to the database pool.

subject: Database size
content: The Cloud SQL instance uses the smallest shared-core tier with ten gigabytes of storage and automatic storage increases enabled.

subject: Embedding model
content: Embeddings come from the Vertex AI gemini-embedding-001 model, truncated to 768 dimensions and normalized before they are stored.

subject: Arbiter model
content: Relation classification uses gemini-3-flash-preview on the global Vertex endpoint with low thinking to keep latency down.

subject: Upload retention
content: Uploaded chat exports are stored in Cloud Storage and deleted automatically by a lifecycle rule after thirty days.

subject: Rate limits
content: Each user can make one hundred and twenty light requests and twenty heavy requests per minute before getting rate limited.

subject: Handoff benchmark
content: Run the long multi-session handoff benchmark at three budgets and record the results in the README.

subject: Custom domain
content: Decide whether to move the service to a web.app address through Firebase Hosting or to a purchased domain.
